tool_input.command:
mkdir -p docs/policies && cat > docs/policies/tls-verification.md <<'EOF'
# TLS certificate verification

The project's current recorded decision is that TLS certificate verification stays enabled on all builds, development builds included, going forward. Local and development testing that needs TLS uses self-signed certificates rather than turning verification off. Plain http to internal hosts behind the firewall is acceptable, but that does not relax verification for any TLS connection.
EOF
